thread:
olivia: Heads-up — canary in eu-west failed during post-upgrade health checks. Deploybot paused the promotion. Pods hitting CrashLoopBackOff on postupgrade-hook, not user traffic yet.
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary health failed (1742109999) job=release/api-service chart=api-service v=2.3.1 status=canary-paused reason=postupgrade-hook-timeout logs=/deploy/logs/1742109999
mike: @olivia can you paste the values diff? wondering if HPA/minReplicas changed or affinity caused node binpacking.
olivia: quick diff:
```
# values diff
replicaCount: 3 -> 1
hpa:
  minReplicas: 2 -> 1
affinity: removed zone anti-affinity
postUpgradeHook:
  timeoutSeconds: 300 -> 120
```
Hook timeout dropped and affinity changed — likely explains hook racing out and crashlooping.
lina: recommendation: pin chart for eu-west to 2.3.0 (pre-change) and do an image-only hotfix (2.3.1+imagefix) promotion for other regions. That keeps eu-west stable while we validate extended hook time.
sre-oncall: +1. Also suggest running a manual preflight in a eu-west staging cluster with postUpgradeHook timeout bumped to 600 before unpin.
olivia: plan I will enact now:
- add annotation on release in eu-west to pin chart to 2.3.0: `redwood/release-pin: eu-west=2.3.0`
- promote image-only build `api-service:2.3.1-fix1` to non-eu regions
- open PR to revert hook timeout and restore affinity after verification
Targeting a short maintenance window (30m monitor, up to 2h change window). @mike can you handle release notes + docs blurb?
mike: I'll draft RN: "Release coordination: eu-west pinned to 2.3.0 due to postupgrade hook timeout; image-only patch promoted globally where applicable. Follow-up: extended preflight and affinity restore." Will post to #release-notes and tag product/docs.
sam: If the eu-west staging preflight passes with timeout=600 we can cut a follow-up chart 2.3.2 with the hook change and a safer rollout policy.
deploy-bot: action: applied annotation `redwood/release-pin=eu-west=2.3.0` (id=pin-1742109999). Promotion: api-service image `2.3.1-fix1` promoted to regions: us-west, ap-south. Canary resumes blocked for eu-west.
olivia: thanks. Monitoring for 30m; if we still see CrashLoopBackOff after manual preflight, we'll roll back to previous replica set and open postmortem. Otherwise we'll schedule chart 2.3.2 with extended preflight next week. :eyes:
